name: @pieai/university
description: University — one browser app in two modes, and the authoring server behind one of them.

scripts.boundaries: node apps/local/scripts/check-module-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-kit-portability.mjs && node scripts/check-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-raw-colours.mjs && node scripts/check-shared-styles.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs
scripts.primm:preview: pnpm --filter @pieai/university-grading-service exec tsc --noEmit false --outDir .primm-preview-build && node scripts/primm-preview.mjs --owner-preview --with-app
scripts.docs:check: pnpm pro-gov doctor && pnpm doc-gov router-check && pnpm doc-gov check && pnpm doc-gov scan --check && pnpm doc-gov links && pnpm doc-gov audit && pnpm doc-gov doctor
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && node --test scripts/check-contrast.test.mjs && node scripts/check-raw-colours.mjs --self-test && node scripts/check-review-card-registry.mjs --self-test && node scripts/check-content-revisions.mjs --self-test && node apps/university/scripts/check-public-boundary.mjs --self-test && node --test scripts/link-studies-into-worktree.test.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:generated-format && pnpm test && pnpm boundaries && pnpm check:canvas && pnpm check:review-cards && pnpm check:experience && pnpm build && pnpm check:shelf && pnpm check:public-boundary && pnpm check:catalog && pnpm check:content-revisions && pnpm check:export-freshness && pnpm check:lesson-links && pnpm check:activities && pnpm bundle && pnpm docs:check
